## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: multiple Technology and Financial names ABOVE TREND (NVDA, MSFT, MS, AMZN) and sector gains led by Tech/Consumer Discretionary; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — growth/momentum leadership concentrated.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology leading: ORCL (1W: +18.62% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +9.85% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: AMZN (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +17.36%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +14.19% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY. Financials constructive: MS (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +23.07%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -4.62% | 1M: -5.23%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -5.03% | 1M: -1.98%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: WMT (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -0.77%) BELOW TREND, PG (sentiment negative) at risk. Healthcare showing weakness: LLY (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +18.62% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +14.19% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY, AVGO (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +17.36%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +31.31%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — concentrated gains.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: EOG (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -1.58%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND, VZ (1W: -4.86% | 1M: -10.33%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -5.03% | 1M: -1.98%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy and select Healthcare.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: ORCL (1W: +18.62%), TSLA (1W: +14.19%), AVGO (1W: +13.14%), AMZN (1W: +12.32%), AMD (1W: +11.35%). Divergence: limited — TSLA and HD (HD (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -1.07%) RECOVERY) show short-term RECOVERY patterns but overall momentum confirms the RISK-ON tilt.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology constructive with multiple leaders ABOVE TREND: ORCL (1W: +18.62% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +9.85% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND. Sector performance: 1W +4.81% across 24 names supporting growth/momentum leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials positive with pockets of strength: MS (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +23.07%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +1.87%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +2.43%) ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +7.46%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: constructive (20 names).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed to weak: UNH (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND but JNJ (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND; watch MRK (+60 sentiment) as a potential catalyst while overall sector shows headwinds across 17 names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective Growth/Momentum exposure into leading Tech and Consumer Discretionary names (NVDA (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +17.36%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +23.07%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to Energy and weak Staples/Healthcare (XOM (1W: -4.62% | 1M: -5.23%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND). Style: Growth/Momentum confirmed by Technology leadership but leadership concentration is narrow — be selective.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +18.62% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +17.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: LLY (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -4.62% | 1M: -5.23%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (1W +4.81% across 24 names) and Consumer Discretionary (1W +3.32% across 14 names). BEARISH: Energy (1W -3.69% across 10 names) and Consumer Staples/Healthcare where sentiment and price are diverging.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA for follow-through above this week’s highs to confirm continued ABOVE TREND momentum; ORCL sustaining gains over the month confirms an accumulation breakout; TSLA needs 1M stabilization to validate RECOVERY; JPM needs to clear recent weekly resistance to exit CORRECTION.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
JNJ (+60): pipeline/upbeat Q1 headlines — JNJ (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND, sentiment diverging from price. V (+50): Visa expands blockchain initiatives — V (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +1.87%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirms price strength.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
CVS (-75): Chapter 11 liquidation headline — CVS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND, news confirming downside. LLY (-50): FDA data request on obesity drug — LLY (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND, news and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, favor Growth/Momentum. NVDA (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +9.85% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +17.36%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: leadership is narrow (Tech concentrated) and negative Healthcare/Staples headlines (CVS, LLY) are a divergence to monitor.
